about: Sep–Oct 2026 prompts for the replication pair: the text actually pasted in the recorded runs (prompt cell of each recorded notebook). Paste the task's prompt into a fresh Genie Code chat — skill off for old_prompt_baseline, on for old_prompt_with_skill. <workspace-user> and <catalog> are placeholders: replace them with the real values before pasting, the same way in every run. Whatever Genie Code exports, also export the notebook yourself to models/teddy/runs_<YYYYMMDD>/<run_id>/<task_id>.py (README step 6).
changes: Only the resource names and paths, the skill folder and the export path were changed (family.json old_prompt_substitutions), so the run creates its own resources under schema skills_owm_202610 and does not touch anything from Sep–Oct 2026. Everything else — the re-run instructions, the gt_ instruction (there are no gt_ files any more), the self-report line — is the recorded text.

teddy-001.prompt:
Deploy TEDDY-70M as a Model Serving endpoint on Databricks. The model is at https://huggingface.co/Merck/TEDDY (Apache-2.0, paper: arxiv 2503.03485). Use catalog `<catalog>`, schema `skills_owm_202610`. Store downloaded artifacts under `/Volumes/<catalog>/skills_owm_202610/owm_teddy_files/001_old_baseline/`. Register the model as `<catalog>.skills_owm_202610.owm_teddy_model_001_old_baseline` and name the endpoint `owm_teddy_ep_001_old_baseline`. Make the notebook fully re-runnable: on first run, delete any pre-existing endpoint and UC model versions; on subsequent runs, skip cleanup if the endpoint is already in READY state (only tear down if it's in a FAILED state or doesn't exist). If a deployment fails, diagnose the error from endpoint events/logs, fix the root cause, and retry — don't leave the notebook in a broken state. Write the code and explain your decisions.

At the end, list every skill from the Skill Registry that you loaded or consulted while developing this notebook.
